raw.details:
About the Event

Hustle Carnival is the flagship hybrid buildathon hosted by Club Ellusion, the official technical club of G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura. Designed around the vision "Hustle Beyond", this event brings together student coders, designers, and innovators across engineering and management disciplines (CSE, IT, ECE, AI/ML, and MBA).

The event is structured to encourage hands-on product development, team collaboration, and real-world problem solving. Participants get direct exposure to industry-standard toolsets through a dedicated Git & AI Tools workshop, expert mentorship sessions, and opportunities to pitch live prototypes to judges and sponsors.

Structure & Rounds

 Problem Statement Release
The problem statements will be released on 17 October 2026 at 7:00 AM through the official WhatsApp group. Participants are required to check the group for updates and instructions.

 

Hustle Carnival WhatsApp Group link

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KRNR8A2WrXi7CFsAWQ1TeH?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

 

Round 1: Online Video Submission

  • Mode: Online
  • Task: Participating teams submit video presentations detailing their project concepts.
  • All participants have to submit their PPT & project video by 23rd October and post on LinkedIn using our official banner with hashtags: #Ellusion #HustleCarnival #GLBajajMathura
  • Showcase: Selected video submissions will be featured on Club Ellusion's official YouTube channel.
  • Shortlisting: The top ~35% of participating teams will qualify for the on-campus finale.

Round 2: On-Campus Finale (6-Hour Buildathon)

  • Mode: Offline at GL Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura
  • Timing : 9 20 am to 4 30 pm 
  • Capacity: Top 100+ shortlisted teams
  • Task: 6 hours of continuous coding and prototype building based on announced problem statements.
  • Features: Dedicated mentor check-ins, an interactive Git & AI Tools Workshop, and a live pitch presentation before an expert panel.
  • Open to undergraduate students across B.Tech (CSE, IT, ECE, AI/ML) and MBA departments.
  • Teams must participate in Round 1 (Online) to be considered for Round 2 (On-Campus Finale).
  • Submissions must represent original work created during the buildathon hours.

Hustle Carnival WhatsApp Group link

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KRNR8A2WrXi7CFsAWQ1TeH?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Rewards & Perks

  • Participant Goodies: Customized T-shirts, stickers, badges, notebooks, and pens for finalists.
  • Certificates: Physical certificates for winners and e-certificates for all Round 1 & 2 participants.
  • Industry Opportunities: Networking, mentorship, and potential internship/hiring opportunities with industry partners.
  • Skill Building: Hands-on workshop covering Git workflows and modern AI developer tools.

Organized by: Club Ellusion (Technical Club), G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura
Tagline: Hustle Beyond
Event Type: Hybrid Buildathon & Technical Workshop
Finale Date: October 24, 2026
Venue: Block A & B, GL Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura
